messages:
Docs Bot: automated scan finished — found 24 shortlinks returning 404 across /runtime-guide and /kb. sample: /r/2f7a, /r/3b9d, /r/99aa. full CSV attached to the scan run.
Olivia Chen: heads up — I noticed these while updating the runtime upgrade notes. small set look like they used to point to onboarding slides that no longer exist.
Samir Patel: can you paste the CSV or a sample mapping? happy to take a chunk.
Olivia Chen: pasted first 6 below, and opened a draft PR with tentative redirects: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 (WIP)
Olivia Chen: ```csv
shortlink,target
/r/2f7a,/docs/runtime/overview
/r/3b9d,/docs/runtime/batching
/r/99aa,/docs/kb/old-onboarding (404)
```
Kevin R.: quick thought — if an obvious mapping exists -> redirect. if target is dead or ambiguous -> delete and add a tiny note in the changelog so users know it was removed.
Marta Gomez: @Olivia I looked at PR 4123. For /r/99aa the original slide set is gone; I suggest redirect to /docs/kb/migration-notes and add a short explain paragraph in that target about removed onboarding slides.
Jules: FYI our release train for docs deploy is tomorrow noon PDT. If this needs a redirect rule in CDN we should merge before the deploy cutoff.
Samir Patel: I can review the PR tonight. Olivia — can you include a one-line rationale on each redirect row (just a comment in the PR)? makes review faster.
Olivia Chen: good call. I'll add inline comments and include the sed snippet I used to generate the redirect file.
Olivia Chen: ```bash
# generate redirects from CSV (safe preview)
awk -F, 'NR>1 {print "rewrite " $1 " " $2 ";"}' redirects.csv > preview.conf
# run local check script
./tools/check-redirects.sh preview.conf
```
Marta Gomez: pinging infra — any special considerations for shortlink rewrites? @Kevin R. do we need a separate CDN purge?
Kevin R.: if it's a standard path rewrite served by our static edge, no purge required — rules are live on deploy. If we change object paths we purge. Redirects-only -> fine.
Jules: decision summary please: 1) attempt redirect if clear 2) if dead/unclear -> delete shortlink + add changelog note 3) target owner should approve text if we add explanation. Is that everyone? :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: +1
Marta Gomez: +1
Olivia Chen: I'll update PR 4123 with comments and tag owners for the ambiguous ones. aiming to merge before docs deploy cutoff (tomorrow 11:30 PDT).
Docs Bot: reminder — deploy cutoff set for 2024-07-16T18:30:00Z. If PR not merged by then it will go in the next cycle.
Olivia Chen: thanks — will update here once merged.
Samir Patel: if anything blocks review ping me, I can fast-track.
Olivia Chen: merged and deployed redirect rules for the clear mappings, left 4 ambiguous items with owner requests in the PR. Notes added per mapping. Thanks everyone. :party_popper:
